corrections.reason: The final character on L11 is ስ, which wraps onto L12 (ለ ማስተማር) to form the preposition ስለ ማስተማር ('for teaching'), matching L23-24 (ስለ ማስተማርም).
Both the printed glyph (showing the 7th-order right-loop of ሞ) and Amharic grammar require ተርጉሞታልና ('for he has interpreted it').
The printed glyph in the root Ge'ez quote clearly shows the two-crowned ሠ (ሡ) in ለቁሡላን, matching ቁሡላነ on lines 5 and 6 immediately below.
The printed glyph is ሖ (7th order of ሐ) in አፍትሖሙ, quoting the Ge'ez root verb from Col 1 L40.
